title: Analysis Location/Spot Coordinates
description: Location of the analysis on the sample surface. For spot and transect analysis: stage coordinates (X, Y in µm) or a description relative to a named reference feature (e.g., mineral rim, inclusion boundary). For mapping: coordinates of the map corner(s) or centre, plus map dimensions. Enables spatial reconstruction and co-registration with other analytical images.
